hero_sub.text: Automatically mutes every background tab so only the one you're focused on plays audio. No more competing sounds from forgotten tabs.

sec_features_title.text: Focus on what you're listening to

f1_d.text: Background tabs are automatically muted the moment you switch away. Only the active tab plays audio, no configuration needed.

f2_d.text: Videos in PiP mode keep playing audio even when their tab is in the background. Never lose your video's sound.

f3_d.text: Toggle muting on or off instantly with Ctrl+Shift+M. Customize it in Safari's extension settings.

f4_d.text: Keep specific sites unmuted at all times. Perfect for music players, video calls, or any site that should always have audio.

f5_d.text: Switching between Safari windows automatically mutes the previous window's tabs. Audio follows your focus everywhere.

f6_d.text: Fully localized across 33 languages, so Auto Mute Tab speaks yours.

s1_d.text: Download Auto Mute Tab from the App Store. It's a lightweight Safari extension.

s2_d.text: Open Safari Settings, go to Extensions, and enable Auto Mute Tab. Grant permission for all websites.

s3_d.text: That's it. Background tabs go silent automatically. Switch tabs and only the focused one plays audio.

sec_why_title.text: The mute button Safari should have

w1_d.text: Multiple tabs playing audio at the same time is distracting. Auto Mute Tab ensures only one tab is heard at a time, automatically and instantly.

w2_d.text: Handles HTML5 video and audio, Web Audio API, autoplay videos, iframes, and dynamically loaded media. If it makes sound, Auto Mute Tab controls it.

w3_d.text: No analytics, no tracking, no accounts, no servers. Everything runs locally in Safari. Your browsing stays completely private.

req.text: Requires iOS 15, iPadOS 15, or macOS 14 or later, with Safari. Available in 33 languages.

f_brand.text:
Indie macOS software studio.
Building focused, privacy-first tools.

carousel_sub.text: Privacy-first apps for macOS, iOS, and Safari.

fr1_t.text: Silences sound the mute button misses

fr1_d.text: Sites like YouTube, Twitch, and X route audio through the Web Audio API, which slips past the normal tab mute. Auto Mute Tab silences them anyway.

fr2_t.text: Pin a tab to keep playing

fr2_d.text: Keep one background tab audible while everything else stays muted, perfect for music or a call.

fr3_t.text: Mute the active tab on demand

fr3_d.text: Silence the tab you are looking at with one tap, without leaving the page.

fr4_d.text: A dedicated page lists every tab Auto Mute is muting, with one-click unmute.

fr5_d.text: Add music players, video calls, or any site that should never be muted.

fr6_d.text: Audio comes back correctly after your Mac or device wakes from sleep, a case many tab muters miss.

fr7_d.text: A background tab that suddenly starts playing is muted the instant it makes sound.

fr8_d.text: No accounts, no tracking, no network requests, and near-zero impact on browsing speed.
